start.t: Sky Haters have been hitting Skylanders near you. Clean it up and I'll owe you one.

end.t: That's how the SP does it. Good work.

start.t: Fighting is the real training! C-Souls keep popping up around you - wanna go?

end.t: Haha, now THAT was fun. Don't tell Fox Girl I skipped my shift.

start.t: Um... could you help me? I want to get stronger. So nobody gets taken again.

end.t: ...Thank you. Sorry for yelling earlier. I don't yell. Usually.

start.t: Vice captain training! I need a sparring buddy - let's beat some heads!

end.t: Ticking Time Bomb, baby! Hahaha! Same time tomorrow?

start.t: (cough) Government agents are sniffing around. Help me lose them. Don't ask why.

end.t: ...Thanks. One day I'll tell you the rest.

start.t: SR stragglers still hide near the Capital. A Royal could use... an escort. Just this once.

end.t: Not bad. For a commoner. ...Thank you.

start.t: I've almost got my element! Help me practice - set up some targets!

end.t: Zane the Magical Mage grows ever closer to greatness!

start.t: Some fake rappers took our new spot, yo. Help us take it back.

end.t: That's what's good! Green Garry salutes you.

start.t: Garry's busy. Be my hype man while I clear these chumps out, yo!

end.t: Purple Stevie! When I hop on the mic... okay you know the rest.

start.t: Prove you're not the weakest one here. Go hunt.

end.t: ...Fine. You're not the weakest. That's still me. Don't tell anyone.

start.t: Royal knights still loyal to the old crown. Show me your form.

end.t: Hmph. Better than Keita, at least.

start.t: Keep the monsters away while I nap... I mean, while I keep watch. ...zzz.

end.t: Mm? Oh, you did it all. Nice. ...zzz.

start.t: One on one is boring. Eight on two, now THAT'S a fight. You in?

end.t: Hahaha! Okay, you can fight. Persephone will like you.

start.t: Possessed things roam where demons died. Help me put them to rest.

end.t: ...Thank you. I don't say that a lot.

start.t: Government elites hunt my people. Hunt them back.

end.t: Good. Keita could learn from you.

start.t: I need combat data against Elementalists. You'll do.

end.t: Marvelous numbers. Let's keep working together.

start.t: I built a new shield! Can you test it against some guards? Don't tell Sintrie.

end.t: It held! Haha - see? We help who we can.

start.t: Something corrupted is out there. I'll track it, you smash it.

end.t: Data recovered. You're useful. ...That's a compliment.

start.t: Gov agents. Fast and quiet. Keep up.

end.t: You didn't see me. Good job.

start.t: *sniff* These guys were mean to me... jk. Help me beat them up.

end.t: Hehe! You're fun. I'll tell Zack about you.
